BiblicalUsage: Gazzam is one of the Nethinim, the temple servants who returned from exile. The children of Gazzam are listed among the returnees in Ezra 2:48 and again in Nehemiah 7:51. His family came home to serve in the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: Two lists, Ezra's and Nehemiah's, both carry the name of Gazzam, and I take that as proof that God counts His servants twice over. The Nethinim came home to serve, and I hold that no service in His house is small.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
